svg.title: Anatomy of a unique product identifier
svg.desc: A unique product identifier in the GS1 Digital Link form: https://dpp.oydapp.eu/01/09520123456788/21/000002. The domain belongs to the economic operator and can be pointed at any custodian; 01 introduces the 14-digit product code (GTIN), whose last digit is a check digit; 21 introduces the serial number of one item. A data carrier – QR code, Data Matrix, NFC or RFID – holds only this link. The path also says what the passport describes: /01/ alone for a model, /01/…/10/… for a batch, /01/…/21/… for one item. Which of the three a product group needs is set by its delegated act; batteries need one passport per item.
svg.text: THE UNIQUE PRODUCT IDENTIFIER – ONE WEB LINK
a name you own and can
THE PATH SAYS WHAT THE PASSPORT DESCRIBES
Which of the three a product group needs is set by its delegated act. Batteries: one passport per item.
